title: AI-powered Precision Recycling System (WIMPLE)
summary: Seoreu reports that WIMPLE enabled cleaner recycling collection in previously unsorted Busan public spaces and improved collection planning.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Busan Facilities Corporation pilot separates recyclables at the point of disposal. Seoreu reports better separation, reduced contamination, and improved collection scheduling. A related Canadian sorting system reportedly achieved over 98% accuracy. Wider recycling-rate targets and pollution benefits are presented as future or general effects, rather than measured outcomes of the Busan pilot.
purpose: Improve collection and separation of recyclable materials.
location: Busan, South Korea; Canada (related sorting development)

ratings.reason: The Busan Facilities Corporation pilot reportedly enabled recycling collection in previously unsorted public spaces and improved material separation.
The submission describes environmental mechanisms but gives no measured emissions, pollution, or ecosystem change for the pilot.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: AI-powered Precision Recycling System (WIMPLE)

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: WIMPLE enables recycling collection in Busan public spaces

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
